pages.description: The pages of the sheet, in print order.

guides.description: The guide lines on every page, in mm: `x` for the upright lines, `y` for the flat ones, each from the paper's edge.

grid.description: The grid's cell on every page in mm. 0 for no grid.

landscape.description: Lays the A4 sheet on its side, 297 by 210 mm, for every page that has no format of its own. Left out, upright.

words.description: The sheet's Lernwörter (words to learn), one to a line as typed. Left out, the sheet has none.

breaks.description: The word breaks set by hand for the whole sheet: each word in lower case, with the places it breaks at, as counts of characters. Left out, the module's own breaks apply.

on.description: Whether page numbers print at all. Left out, they do not.

at.description: Where the number prints: "bottom" centred at the foot, "right" at the foot's right, "outer" at the outer foot corner (left on even pages, right on odd), "top" at the top right. Left out, "bottom".

form.description: How the number reads: "n" for 2, "seite" for Seite 2, "of" for 2 / 5, "seiteVon" for Seite 2 von 5. Left out, "n".

notFirst.description: Leaves the number off the first page. Left out, the first page is numbered.

black.description: Prints the number in black. Left out, it is grey.

pageNumbers.description: The page numbers printed on each page. Left out, none are printed.

blocks.description: The blocks printed on this page, drawn in order.

guides.description: The page's own guide lines in mm, beside the sheet's. Left out, the page has none of its own.

grid.description: The grid's cell on this page in mm, in place of the sheet's. 0 for no grid. Left out, the sheet's grid applies.

landscape.description: Lays this page on its side, 297 by 210 mm, in place of the sheet's format. Left out, the sheet's format applies.

type.description: What the block is; the other fields depend on it.

id.description: Unique id of the block on its sheet.

x.description: Distance in mm from the left edge of the page to the left edge of the block, before any turn. The page is 210 mm wide upright.

y.description: Distance in mm from the top edge of the page to the top edge of the block, before any turn. The page is 297 mm tall upright.

w.description: Width of the block in mm, before any turn.

h.description: Height of the block in mm, before any turn.

z.description: Stacking order on the page: a block with a higher z lies over one with a lower z.

locked.description: True when the block is locked, so the editor does not move, resize or turn it. Absent means not locked.

mark.description: Numbering printed before the block on paper, such as "1.", "a)" or "(1)", or a symbol's code. Absent means none.

group.description: The ids of the groups the block belongs to, the outermost group first. Absent when the block is in no group.

angle.description: Turn of the block about its centre, in degrees clockwise. 0 is upright, 90 a quarter turn. Absent means 0.

flipX.description: True mirrors the block from left to right inside its box, so a picture or a symbol faces the other way. Absent means not mirrored.

flipY.description: True mirrors the block from top to bottom inside its box. Absent means not mirrored.

keep.description: True keeps the width in proportion to the height when the block is resized, as PowerPoint's Lock aspect ratio does. Absent means off.

text.description: The words of the text as one plain string, with no look of their own. Always the same words as `rich`.

rich.description: The paragraphs with their own looks. Absent when one look covers the whole text: `text` then holds all of it.

syllables.description: True draws a bow under each syllable of each word (Silbenbögen). Absent means off.

breaks.description: The words the teacher split by hand into syllables. Absent means the program alone splits the words.

tints.description: The two colours the syllables take in turn, the first and then the second, such as blue and red. Absent means the syllables are not coloured in turn.

tintsAcross.description: True carries the colour turn on from word to word through the text. Absent means each word starts again with the first colour.

gapWidth.description: Every gap in the text is at least this many mm wide, so a pupil has room to write. Absent or 0 means each gap is only as wide as its word. Capped at 200 mm.

bank.description: Seed for the box of hidden words set under the text (Lösungswörter). The box shows the words shuffled in an order this seed sets. Absent means no box.

lines.description: Numbers the lines of the text as they break, in the margin. 1 numbers every line, 5 every fifth line. Absent means no numbers.

linesFrom.description: The number of the first line, for the numbering in `lines`. Absent means 1.

mix.description: Seed for the scrambled words (Schüttelwörter). Each word shows its letters in another order, the same on every draw. Absent means no scrambling.

mixFirst.description: True keeps the first letter of each scrambled word in place. Absent means the first letter is scrambled too.

mixCaps.description: True sets the letters of the scrambled words in capitals.

mixLine.description: Where the pupil writes each scrambled word: "after" puts a line after it, "under" a line under it. Absent means no line, except that a list draws it after each word.

list.description: True makes the text draw the sheet's Lernwörter, one word to a paragraph (Text aus Lernwörtern). Its own text stays as it is and is not shown.

listCols.description: The number of columns the list words fill, column by column. Absent means 1.

holes.description: Lückenwörter for a linked text: "one" gives one letter of each word as a gap, "second" every second letter, "vowels" the vowels. Absent means no gaps.

holeSeed.description: Seed that picks which letters become gaps under `holes`. The same seed gives the same gaps on every draw. Absent means 0.

size.description: Font size of the text in pt (points).

align.description: Horizontal alignment of the lines in the box: "left", "center" or "right".

font.description: Typeface, one of the keys of FONTS, such as "andika" (the school print). Absent means andika.

bold.description: True sets the whole text in bold. Absent means off.

italic.description: True sets the whole text in italic. Absent means off.

underline.description: True underlines the whole text. Absent means off.

color.description: Colour of the text as a hex colour, such as "#222222". Absent means #222222.

spacing.description: Distance from one line of the text to the next, as a multiple of the font size. Absent means 1.3.

valign.description: Vertical place of the text in its box: "top", "middle" or "bottom". Absent means top.

kind.description: Outline of the box the text sits in: "rect", "rounded", "circle", "triangle", "star" or "bubble". Absent means rect.

fill.description: Colour inside the box as a hex colour. "none" or absent means no fill.

opacity.description: How solid the fill is: 0 is invisible, 1 is solid. Absent means 1.

stroke.description: Colour of the border as a hex colour. "none" or absent means no border.

strokeOpacity.description: How solid the border is: 0 is invisible, 1 is solid. Absent means 1.

inside.description: True keeps a circle's, triangle's or star's text inside its outline, shrunk to fit, rather than growing the shape. Absent means off.

floor.description: Set by the editor on a shape whose text the teacher has sized: the text then keeps at least 10 pt. Absent means off.

strokeWidth.description: Width of the border in mm. Absent means 0.5.

dash.description: Style of the border: "dashed" for dashes, "dotted" for dots. Absent means a solid border.

trace.description: Nachspuren: the text prints in grey to write over. true is plain grey, "outline" a thin outline of the letters, "dotted" dotted letters (in fonts that have them, else grey). Absent means no trace text.

fade.description: How the grey of a trace text fades: "row" fades each row from left to right, "rows" fades the rows step by step down the block. Absent means no fade. Needs `trace`.

runs.description: The stretches of the paragraph in reading order, each with its own look.

list.description: Makes the paragraph an item of a list: "bullet" for a dot, "number" for a count. Absent means no list.

level.description: How far the paragraph is moved in, in steps, from 0 (flush left) to 2. Absent means 0.

text.description: The words of this stretch. In a gap, the answer: the pupil's sheet shows a line in its place.

bold.description: True makes the stretch bold, false makes it plain. Absent takes the block's setting.

italic.description: True makes the stretch italic, false makes it upright. Absent takes the block's setting.

underline.description: True underlines the stretch, on top of the block's own underline. Absent means no extra underline.

color.description: Colour of the stretch as a hex colour, such as "#e02424", on top of the block's colour. Absent takes the block's colour.

gap.description: True makes the stretch a gap of a Lückentext. On the pupil's sheet it is a line to write on, as wide as its words. The editor shows the words in grey, the answer key in the gap's colour.

kind.description: Outline of the box the text sits in: "rect", "rounded", "circle", "triangle", "star" or "bubble". Absent means rect.

fill.description: Colour inside the box as a hex colour. "none" or absent means no fill.

stroke.description: Colour of the border as a hex colour. "none" or absent means no border.

strokeWidth.description: Width of the border in mm. Absent means 0.5.

from.description: For a line or an arrow: the corner of the box where it starts, "nw" top left, "ne" top right, "sw" bottom left, "se" bottom right. The line runs to the opposite corner. Absent means "nw".

ticks.description: True puts a short cross stroke at each end of a line. Absent means no ticks.

label.description: Prints the length of a line: "show" on the sheet, "key" on the answer key only. Absent means no length.

color.description: The colour of the lines, as a six digit hex colour such as #1a56db.

text.description: Text printed on the lines, in the block's font. Left out, the lines stand alone.

font.description: The font of the text printed on the lines. Left out, the default font is used.

trace.description: Trace text the pupil writes over: true for grey, "outline" or "dotted". Left out, no trace.

fade.description: How the trace fades as the pupil writes on: "row" along each row, "rows" from row to row. Left out, it does not fade.

list.description: Takes its words from the sheet's words to learn (Lernwörter), one to a row, in the way the mode says. Left out, no list.

from.description: Index of the first word to learn the block shows, counted from 0, so a ruled pattern run on over several pages picks up where the last one stopped. Left out, 0.

folds.description: Number of empty columns to write in on a fold sheet (Knickblatt), after the words. 2 or 3. Any other value gives 2.

house.description: Draws a house on the lines of a kind with zones, marking its room, roof and cellar. Left out, no house.

houseTint.description: Tints the house: "room" for the room alone, "all" for roof, room and cellar. Left out, the house is not tinted.

band.description: Whether the middle band between the lines is tinted. Left out, the kind's own default applies.

bandColor.description: The band's colour, as a six digit hex colour such as #ffe066. Left out, the line colour, paler, is used.

syllables.description: Draws an arc under each syllable of the text on the lines. Left out, no arcs.

breaks.description: The word breaks set by hand for the text on the lines. They win over the sheet's breaks. Left out, the sheet's apply.

tints.description: Two colours, such as #1a56db and #e02424, that colour the syllables in turn. Left out, no colour.

tintsAcross.description: Carries the colour turn on from word to word, instead of starting again with each word. Left out, it starts again.

y.description: Distance in mm from the top edge of the page to the top edge of the block, before any turn. The page is 297 mm tall upright.

w.description: Width of the block in mm, before any turn.

h.description: Height of the block in mm, before any turn.

z.description: Stacking order on the page: a block with a higher z lies over one with a lower z.

locked.description: True when the block is locked, so the editor does not move, resize or turn it. Absent means not locked.

mark.description: Numbering printed before the block on paper, such as "1.", "a)" or "(1)", or a symbol's code. Absent means none.

group.description: The ids of the groups the block belongs to, the outermost group first. Absent when the block is in no group.

angle.description: Turn of the block about its centre, in degrees clockwise. 0 is upright, 90 a quarter turn. Absent means 0.

flipX.description: True mirrors the block from left to right inside its box, so a picture or a symbol faces the other way. Absent means not mirrored.

flipY.description: True mirrors the block from top to bottom inside its box. Absent means not mirrored.

keep.description: True keeps the width in proportion to the height when the block is resized, as PowerPoint's Lock aspect ratio does. Absent means off.

count.description: Number of triangles on the sheet, side by side in rows of `columns`. Default 4.

columns.description: Number of triangles per row. Default 4.

max.description: The Zahlenraum: the largest number any outer field of a generated triangle shows. One of 10, 20, 100 or 1000. Default 20.

given.description: Which fields show their number. "inner": the three inner fields (easy). "mix": two inner fields and one outer field (medium). "outer": the three outer fields (hard). "free": the fields flagged in `free`. Default "inner".

free.description: With `given` "free": one flag per field, index 0 to 5 (inner 0 to 2, outer 3 to 5). A flagged field shows its number. Missing or invalid: the three inner fields.

empty.description: When true, no field shows a number, so the pupil fills in every field. Default false.

seed.description: Seed for the random triangles. The same seed always gives the same triangles.

typed.description: Numbers the teacher typed into fields. Each entry is [triangle index from 0, field index 0 to 5, value 0 to 9999]. The triangles are then built to hold these numbers.

FieldTyped.description: A number the teacher typed into a field: the triangle's index (from 0), the field's index (0 to 5), the value (0 to 9999).

start.description: The number of the first tick, from 0 up. The line starts here. Default 0.

end.description: The number of the last tick, above `start`. The last tick is the last multiple of `minor` that is not above it. Default 20.

minor.description: The step between two ticks (small ticks), in whole numbers. Default 1.

major.description: The step between two long ticks. A multiple of `minor`. A tick is long when its number minus `start` is a multiple of it. The first tick is always long. Default 5.

labels.description: Which ticks show their number. "all": every tick. "major": the long ticks. "ends": the first and the last tick. "none": no tick. Default "major".

size.description: Font size of the numbers, in pt. Does not change with the block's size. Default 12.

cut.description: Draws a break mark (two short slanted strokes) left of the first tick. Only shown when `start` is above 0. Default false.

tasks.description: "random": boxes and arrows go on ticks chosen from the seed. "free": the ticks in `marks` get their task. Default "random".

boxes.description: Number of boxes placed on the line with `tasks` "random". Default 3.

arrows.description: Number of arrows placed on the line with `tasks` "random". Default 0.

marks.description: The ticks picked in "free" mode, each [number, "box" or "arrow"]. An entry that is not a tick is kept but not drawn.

jumps.description: Draws jump arcs above the line, from the first tick on. Default false.

jump.description: Width of each jump arc, a multiple of `minor`. Default `major`.

arcs.description: A text for each jump arc, by index. A missing or empty entry shows "+" and the jump width.

seed.description: Seed for the random tasks. The same seed always gives the same tasks.

Mark.description: A tick the teacher picked in "free" mode: [the tick's number, its task].

Task.description: A task on a tick: "box" an empty box to write the number in, "arrow" an arrow to draw to the tick.

look.description: What is drawn: "tafel" the Hundertertafel with its numbers in a 10 by 10 grid, "punkte" a field of 10 by 10 dots. Default "tafel".

from.description: The first number of the Tafel: 1 gives 1 to 100, 0 gives 0 to 99. Default 1.

show.description: Which numbers of the Tafel show. "all": every number. "none": no number. "random": all but `hide` cells, picked from the seed, are hidden. "free": all but the cells in `hidden` show. Default "all".

hide.description: Number of cells hidden with `show` "random". Default 20.

hidden.description: Cell indices (0 to 99, row by row from the top left) whose number is hidden with `show` "free".

tint.description: Which cells of the Tafel are tinted. "none": no cell. "even": the even numbers. "times": the multiples of `times` up to 10 times `times`. "row": the row `line`. "column": the column `line`. "free": the cells in `tints`. Default "none".

times.description: The row of the Einmaleins that "times" tints, 1 to 10. Default 2.

line.description: The row or column tinted with "row" or "column", counted from the top or the left, 1 to 10. Default 1.

color.description: The colour of a tint from "even", "times", "row" or "column": 1 yellow, 2 blue. Default 1.

tints.description: Each tinted cell with its colour, for tint "free": [cell index 0 to 99, colour 1 yellow or 2 blue].

cut.description: Cut-out (Ausschnitt): when true, only the cells in `shape` are drawn, and the cell `given` shows its number while the other cells stay empty for the pupil to fill in. Default false.

shape.description: Cell indices (0 to 99) drawn with `cut`. Default a cross: 34, 43, 44, 45, 54. An empty list draws nothing.

given.description: The cell index (0 to 99) that shows its number with `cut`. If it is not in `shape`, the lowest cell of `shape` is used. Default 44.

fill.description: With "count", the first `dots` dots are filled, row by row. With "free", the dots in `filled` are. Default "count".

dots.description: Number of filled dots with `fill` "count", counted row by row from the top left. Default 0.

filled.description: Cell indices (0 to 99) of the filled dots with `fill` "free".

seed.description: Seed for the random hidden cells with `show` "random". The same seed always hides the same cells.

numbers.description: The numbers on the face. "all": 1 to 12. "quarters": only 12, 3, 6 and 9. "none": no numbers. Default "all".

minutes.description: Draws the 60 minute ticks. The 12 hour ticks are always drawn. Default true.

ring.description: Draws a second ring with 13 to 24 inside the numbers. Not drawn when `numbers` is "none". Default false.

task.description: "read": the hands are drawn and the pupil writes the time under the clock. "draw": no hands, the time is written under the clock and the pupil draws the hands. Default "read".

answer.description: The empty answer under a clock with task "read". "box": a digital box `__:__ Uhr`. "line": a writing line. Default "box".

format.description: How the time is written under the clock. "12": `3:30 Uhr`, hours 1 to 12. "24": `15:30 Uhr`, hours 0 to 23. "words": in words, such as "halb vier". Default "12".

region.description: The form of the time in words, with format "words". "nach": "viertel nach drei" and "viertel vor vier". "viertel": "viertel vier" and "dreiviertel vier". Default "nach".

count.description: Number of clocks on the sheet, 1 to 12. Default 4.

cols.description: Number of clocks per row, 1 to 6. The rows fill from the top left. Default 4.

step.description: The minutes that random times keep to: 60 full hours, 30 half hours, 15 quarter hours, 5 or 1 minute. Default 15.

fill.description: "random": every time is drawn from the seed. "free": each clock takes its time from `times`, and from the seed where that is missing. Default "random".

times.description: The time of each clock in minutes since 0:00 (0 to 1439), in clock order. A missing or -1 entry takes a random time. Used with fill "free".

seed.description: Seed for the random times. The same seed always gives the same times.

form.description: How the child checks her results. "mixed": the results in a shuffled list, each with a box to tick. "word": a Lösungswort with a letter box under each task. "sum": one control sum per linked block. Default "mixed".

links.description: Ids of the linked maths blocks of the sheet, in the order the teacher ticked them. Default none.

word.description: The Lösungswort the child builds from the letters, as the teacher typed it. Used with form "word" only. Default "".

title.description: The heading of the block. An empty heading prints none. Default "Selbstkontrolle".

size.description: Font size of the text in pt, except the heading, which is 1.2 times it. Default 14.

turn.description: Turns the block for the child to read it later. "none": not turned. "upside": the whole content turned by 180 degrees. "fold": a dashed fold line along the top, with "Hier umknicken" over it, and the content turned by 180 degrees under it, so the child folds it back. Default "none".

seed.description: Seed for the shuffle of form "mixed" and of the table of form "word". The same seed always gives the same order.

x.description: The upright guide lines, each the distance in mm from the paper's left edge.

y.description: The flat guide lines, each the distance in mm from the paper's top edge.
